desc:
• PANCAKE MIX AND MORE: Use Bisquick to craft deliciously fluffy pancakes, waffles, biscuits, and beyond; An ideal ingredient in your favorite breakfast, dinner, or dessert recipes

  • ORIGINAL BISQUICK: Make it your go-to mix for pancakes, waffles, biscuits, and more - so many ways to Bisquick; It's the perfect pantry staple

  • BETTY CROCKER QUALITY: Made with no colors and no artificial flavors, so the great taste of your recipes shines through

  • CUSTOMIZE CREATIONS: Add toppings like syrup, whipped cream, chocolate chips, butter, fruit, breakfast sausage crumbles, or whatever you dream up

  • CONTAINS: One 96 oz Giant Size box of Betty Crocker Bisquick Original Pancake and Baking Mix; Makes about 145 pancakes
features:
Features

All-in-one baking mix: Versatile enough for pancakes, waffles, biscuits, muffins, dumplings, coffee cake, and even savory dishes like chicken pot pie.

No artificial flavors or colors: Made with clean and simple ingredients you can trust.

Large size: The 40 oz box offers plenty of mix—enough for around 60 pancakes.

Kosher certified: Suitable for those following kosher dietary guidelines.

Reliable blend: Contains enriched bleached flour, vegetable oils, leavening agents, sugar, salt, and starch—perfectly balanced for consistent baking. 

 Benefits

Quick and convenient: Cuts down on prep time—just add milk and eggs to start cooking.

Great texture every time: Produces fluffy pancakes, soft biscuits, and tender muffins with minimal effort.

Multi-use essential: Great for both sweet breakfasts and savory dinners, making it a true pantry staple.

Kid-friendly: Easy to prepare and fun to use for cooking with kids.

Cost-effective: One mix that replaces multiple ingredients—saving you time, money, and space.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Corn Starch, Vegetable Oil (palm, sunflower, canola, and/or high oleic soybean oil), Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Dextrose, Sugar, Salt, Monoglycerides. Contains wheat
